name: Frontliner
desc: Heavy armor, heavy hits, the one in the middle of the fight. Frontliners take what the party cannot, and keep swinging.

coreFeatures.name: Martial Chassis
coreFeatures.desc: You use a d10 hit die. You begin with the armor and weapon proficiencies listed in your role.

coreFeatures.name: Extra Attack
coreFeatures.desc: When you take the Attack action, you may make one additional weapon attack.

coreFeatures.name: Extra Attack (2)
coreFeatures.desc: When you take the Attack action, you may make two additional weapon attacks.

coreFeatures.name: Extra Attack (3)
coreFeatures.desc: When you take the Attack action, you may make three additional weapon attacks.

name: Striker
desc: Speed and precision. Strikers find the opening, hit the weak spot, and are somewhere else when the counterattack comes.

coreFeatures.name: Precise Blow
coreFeatures.desc: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack and you have advantage, or an ally is within 5 ft. of the target, you deal an extra 1d6 damage.

coreFeatures.name: Precise Blow (2d6)
coreFeatures.desc: Your Precise Blow damage increases to 2d6.

coreFeatures.name: Precise Blow (3d6)
coreFeatures.desc: Your Precise Blow damage increases to 3d6.

coreFeatures.name: Precise Blow (4d6)
coreFeatures.desc: Your Precise Blow damage increases to 4d6.

coreFeatures.name: Precise Blow (5d6)
coreFeatures.desc: Your Precise Blow damage increases to 5d6.

name: Caster
desc: Mastery of arcane force. Casters bend magic directly, trading flesh for understanding.

coreFeatures.name: Spellcasting
coreFeatures.desc: You can cast spells. Your spellcasting ability is set by your class subtree. You begin with an MP pool of 10 + your casting modifier.

coreFeatures.name: Cantrips
coreFeatures.desc: You know two cantrips, chosen from a list your class subtree provides.

coreFeatures.name: MP Expansion
coreFeatures.desc: Your MP maximum increases by 15.

coreFeatures.name: Third Cantrip
coreFeatures.desc: You learn an additional cantrip from your class list.

coreFeatures.name: MP Expansion
coreFeatures.desc: Your MP maximum increases by 20.

coreFeatures.name: Fourth Cantrip
coreFeatures.desc: You learn an additional cantrip from your class list.

name: Divine
desc: Power channeled from something older, higher, or stranger. Divines wield magic through their relationship to a power, not through study.

coreFeatures.name: Channeled Power
coreFeatures.desc: You can cast spells. Your spellcasting ability is set by your class subtree. You begin with an MP pool of 10 + your casting modifier.

coreFeatures.name: Divine Focus
coreFeatures.desc: You can use a holy symbol, druidic focus, or appropriate object as a spellcasting focus.

coreFeatures.name: Grace
coreFeatures.desc: Once per short rest, when you fail a saving throw you may reroll it. You must take the new result.

coreFeatures.name: MP Expansion
coreFeatures.desc: Your MP maximum increases by 20.

coreFeatures.name: Greater Grace
coreFeatures.desc: You may use Grace twice per short rest.

name: Support
desc: The force that lifts others. Supports make everyone around them more capable, and tend to outlast fights that should have killed them.

coreFeatures.name: Inspiration
coreFeatures.desc: You have Inspiration dice (d6). As a bonus action, grant one to an ally within 30 ft. who can hear you. They may add it to any one check, attack, or save in the next minute. You have a number equal to your prof bonus, regained on a long rest.

coreFeatures.name: Inspiration (d8)
coreFeatures.desc: Your Inspiration dice become d8s.

coreFeatures.name: Inspiration (d10)
coreFeatures.desc: Your Inspiration dice become d10s.

coreFeatures.name: Inspiration (d12)
coreFeatures.desc: Your Inspiration dice become d12s.

coreFeatures.name: Jack of All Trades
coreFeatures.desc: You add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to any ability check that doesn't already include it.

name: Specialist
desc: The odd shape. Specialists don't fit cleanly into another role, but they bring something nobody else does. Artificers, invokers, planar scholars, strange hybrids.

coreFeatures.name: Signature Craft
coreFeatures.desc: You have one signature practice (a spell, a construct, a ritual, a device) defined by your class subtree. The specifics are set by what you pick.

coreFeatures.name: Flex MP
coreFeatures.desc: You begin with an MP pool of 8 + your choice of INT, WIS, or CHA modifier.

coreFeatures.name: MP Expansion
coreFeatures.desc: Your MP maximum increases by 15.

coreFeatures.name: Second Signature
coreFeatures.desc: You gain a second signature practice from your class subtree.
